title: Scaffold: package, commander root, global flags, output writers, exit codes, paths, config, version, schema
description: PRD §5, §6.1, §6.4, §8.1, §8.3, §10.1, §11. Deliver: package.json (brightspace-cli, bins bs+brightspace, Node >=22.12, ESM, tsc build, tsx dev, biome, node:test), tsconfig, biome.json, AGENTS.md, src/bin/bs.ts, src/cli/program.ts (commander 15; global flags --json --plain --results-only --select --wrap-untrusted --no-input --readonly --color --base-url --root --timeout --verbose --fail-empty with BS_* env; --json+--plain -> exit 2; commander usage errors -> exit 2; SIGINT -> 130), src/core/output.ts (json writer with select/results-only, TSV writer with header + escaping, untrusted wrapper per PRD §10.3), src/core/errors.ts (typed errors + exit code table + next-step messages), src/core/paths.ts (BS_ROOT / env-paths data dir; pure resolution; 0700 dirs), src/core/config.ts (env + config.json tenant knobs), commands: version, schema (walk commander tree; automation.exit_codes; rejects --plain). Tests: output modes, select, results-only, TSV escaping, untrusted wrapping incl. marker sanitization, exit code mapping, paths resolution, schema snapshot. Acceptance: npm run build && npm test && npm run lint green; 'bs --help', 'bs version --json', 'bs schema --json' work from dist.
